title: [spec-gap][R-04-007] Root demotion: Schnorr-signed DEMOTION_REQUEST with >50% vote absent in all stacks; election text diverges from 2a.5.2 (spec 04 6.1)
description:
Spec spec/04-network.md 6.1 'Root Election, Failure, Demotion' (MUST-level retained mechanics): lowest EUI-64 deterministic election, DIO monitoring, >50% vote demotion with Schnorr-signed DEMOTION_REQUEST; root no longer advertises a ULA prefix.

Evidence:
- DEMOTION_REQUEST: zero occurrences in rust/, lichen/, python/src/ (rg DEMOTION_REQUEST|DEMOTION — only group-membership role demotion, unrelated). No Schnorr-signed demotion message type, no >50% vote counter in any stack.
- Root election: spec 04 text says 'lowest EUI-64 deterministic election', but all three stacks implement the 2a.5.2 multi-factor ordering (DODAG preference > stratum > RSSI+SNR score > IID lowest as tiebreak only): rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs:976-1015, python/src/lichen/link/slot_coordination.py:289, C lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tdma_root_select.c:94 + root_selection.c; tests rust multi_instance.rs:2452-2503, lichen/tests/{root_selection,tdma_root_select,multi_root}, python tests/link/test_slot_coordination.py:239-287.
- Partial coverage that does exist: root role transition table test rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs:826 (allows root demotion at role level); root DIO signing infrastructure exists (root_sig.rs, rpl_root_sig.c, root_signature.json) so a signed DEMOTION_REQUEST could reuse it.

Note: the trimmed 04-network text says mechanics 'remain as documented above' but the referenced detailed demotion text is not present in the current file; the requirement itself may need a spec cross-reference fix (the mechanics now live in 2a.5.2 / 09-rpl-profile). Filed as spec-gap because the demotion protocol message has no implementation anywhere.

Suggested placement: message type + vote accounting in rust/lichen-rpl (DODAG state), C lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl, python lichen.rpl; Schnorr48 signing per spec/drafts/draft-lichen-schnorr-00.md. Also amend spec 04 6.1 to point at the actual election/demotion section instead of 'as documented above'.
